# Tokenization request validation (TOK-2291 spec draft v0.4)

Scope: validate_token_request(payload: dict) -> ValidationResult in src/validator.py. Called by the tokenization intake before any PAN is forwarded to the vault.

## card.pan
- Strip spaces and hyphens, then must be digits only, length 13-19.
- Must pass Luhn checksum.
- Failure code: PAN_INVALID.

## card.expiry
- Format MM/YY or MM/YYYY.
- Must not be earlier than the current UTC month.
- Failure codes: EXPIRY_FORMAT, EXPIRY_PAST.

## card.cvv
- Must never be persisted. If cvv is present in any payload with storage=true, reject with CVV_STORED.

## card.billing.address
- country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, required whenever billing is present.
- postal_code: optional, max 12 characters.
- Nested errors use dotted paths, e.g. card.billing.address.country.

## metadata
- Arbitrary JSON object. Maximum nesting depth 4, where the top-level object is depth 1. Failure code: META_DEPTH.
- Keys must be strings of 64 characters or fewer.

## token_policy
- One of SINGLE_USE, MULTI_USE_30D, MULTI_USE_365D. Defaults to SINGLE_USE when absent.

## Text and null handling
- All strings are NFC-normalized before validation.
- null on a required field: E_REQUIRED.
- Empty string on a required field: E_REQUIRED.
- Empty string on an optional field: treated as absent.
